svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Buckets. Central asks Cargo to create a bucket and keys; Cargo reports when the cluster is usable. Cargo calls the Garage admin API on the gateway node over WG Mesh. A bench in a site VM sends S3 over HTTPS to the proxy VM, which forwards over WG Mesh to the Garage gateway node; the gateway stores copies of each object on the storage nodes.

text.tspan: Garage cluster · VMs that Cargo built
